AUX_GREEN_TAG.reason: 綠單 / Green Tag is the procedural placard; SEV_C is the severity classification. Keep separate per README §3.4 / §11.

AUX_WALL_FUNGUS.reason: 壁癌 is a broader complaint (moisture-driven wall degradation incl. paint peeling and plaster loss); CAUSE_term_120 白華 is specifically efflorescence (white crystalline deposit). Phase 1 already lists 壁癌 as alias of 白華 — alias conflict to flag in alias-index phase. The two QA-derived nodes (AUX_EFFLORESCENCE and AUX_WALL_FUNGUS) co-exist by design, so respect that distinction here.

AUX_EMERGENCY_RESPONSE.reason: 緊急應變 (emergency response: evacuate, notify, shut off utilities) ≠ 緊急評估 (emergency post-quake assessment, an inspection task). Different concepts in the response process.

AUX_PRINCIPAL_STRESS_DIRECTION.reason: 主應力方向 (direction) ≠ 主應力 (magnitude). Direction and magnitude are distinct stress-tensor properties.

AUX_STRUCTURAL_DEFORMATION.reason: 結構變形 (any structural deformation) is broader than 側向位移 (lateral displacement, a specific type). 側向位移 should NOT be propagated as alias of AUX_STRUCTURAL_DEFORMATION.

AUX_STRUCTURAL_INTEGRITY.reason: 結構整體性 (system-level integrity) is broader than 結構穩定性 (resistance to instability). Related but distinct properties.

AUX_WATER_INFILTRATION.reason: 滲水/漏水 is the general phenomenon of water entering the structure; 混凝土滲水 (T_term_1177) is the specific damage pattern of seepage through concrete. Keep broader cause-side concept separate.

CAUSE_CONSTRUCTION_JOINT.reason: 施工縫 here is framed as a CAUSE (mechanism producing horizontal cracks). Phase 1 has E_term_426 施工接縫 (element framing), T_term_889 冷縫 (general/observable), and T_term_553 混凝土冷縫 (damage_pattern). None matches the cause-framing exactly. Keep CAUSE_CONSTRUCTION_JOINT as the canonical cause-side node; relate to T_term_553 as the resulting damage pattern.

F_PLASTIC_FAILURE.reason: 塑性破壞: yielded/non-recoverable failure mode. No phase 1 equivalent — terminology has F_term_159/160/168 but not 塑性破壞.

F_BEARING_LOSS.reason: 承載力喪失: end-state of capacity loss. Distinct from 剪力/彎曲/壓力破壞.

CAUSE_REPEATED_SHEAR.reason: 反覆剪力: cyclic shear, the canonical cause of X-shaped cracking. Distinct from 剪力 (TERM_term_016, monotonic shear).

CAUSE_THERMAL_EXPANSION.reason: 熱脹冷縮: thermal-induced stresses. No phase 1 equivalent.

CAUSE_CONCRETE_DETERIORATION.reason: 混凝土劣化: aggregate long-term concrete degradation. Broader than CAUSE_term_988 (老化劣化, general aging) — distinct enough to keep.

CAUSE_DESIGN_INADEQUACY.reason: 設計不足: under-design relative to current seismic code. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_FILLER_REPAIR.reason: 填縫劑修補: residential-grade C-level filler repair. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_SURFACE_REPAIR.reason: 表面修補: cosmetic surface restoration. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_MORTAR_REPAIR.reason: 修補砂漿: mortar patching. Phase 1 has M_term_267 砂漿 (the material) and M_term_663 水泥砂漿; QA's concept is the repair method, not the material.

AUX_RUST_TREATMENT.reason: 除鏽防蝕: rust treatment + protective coating; pre-step for exposed-rebar repair.

AUX_PHOTO_RECORD.reason: 拍照記錄: low-cost resident-level monitoring procedure. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_PLASTER_LAYER.reason: 粉刷層: surface plaster layer (material). Phase 1 has T_term_1179 (粉刷層裂縫, the cracks IN plaster, NOT the material). Keep distinct.

AUX_PROTECTIVE_LAYER_FAILURE.reason: 保護層失效: failure of concrete cover (precursor to rebar exposure). No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_COLLAPSE_RISK.reason: 倒塌風險: probability/risk of collapse. Distinct from 連續性倒塌 (the failure mode itself).

AUX_FALLING_DEBRIS_RISK.reason: 掉落風險: risk of debris falling in spalling areas. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_COST_LOW.reason: 低成本修繕: surface-level repair cost band. Specific instance of AUX_COST_RANGE anchor (anchor's summary explicitly says 'instantiate as AUX_COST_RANGE_<lo>_<hi>').

AUX_COST_MID.reason: 中成本修繕: B-level damage repair cost band. Specific instance of AUX_COST_RANGE anchor.

AUX_COST_HIGH.reason: 高成本修繕: A-level / large-scale retrofit cost band. Specific instance of AUX_COST_RANGE anchor.

AUX_BUILDING_AUTHORITY.reason: 建管處: government building-management authority. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_SAFETY_ASSESSMENT.reason: 安全評估: integrated structural safety assessment process. CODE_term_164 (ATC-20) defines the standard but is not the assessment process itself.

AUX_LOAD_BEARING_ELEMENT.reason: 承重構件: umbrella concept for load-bearing members (柱/梁/剪力牆). Phase 1 has E_term_163 承重牆 (specific to wall) — not the same.

AUX_SURFACE_DAMAGE.reason: 表面損傷: non-structural surface damage; functions as alias of SEV_C in QA but is conceptually a damage scope, not a severity. Note: surface form '表面損傷' is ambiguous between SEV_C and AUX_SURFACE_DAMAGE in the alias index — flag for phase 7.

AUX_NON_STRUCTURAL_DAMAGE.reason: 非結構損傷: structural-vs-non-structural classification. Phase 1 has E_term_161 非結構構件 (the element class), not the damage class.

AUX_COMPOSITE_DAMAGE.reason: 複合損傷: simultaneous co-occurrence of multiple damage types. Distinct from T_SPALLING_WITH_FINE_CRACK (a specific composite anchor).

AUX_OPENING_CORNER.reason: 開口角隅: door/window corner zones (stress-concentration locus). No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_STRESS_REDISTRIBUTION.reason: 應力重分配: post-failure stress transfer mechanism. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_DAMAGE_LEVEL.reason: 損傷等級: the A/B/C grading umbrella concept. Distinct from individual SEV_A/B/C anchors.

AUX_DAMAGE_IDENTIFICATION.reason: 損傷辨識: the act of identifying damage type/location. Distinct from inspection methods.

AUX_RESIDENT_SAFETY.reason: 住戶安全: occupant-safety umbrella concept. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_DOOR_WINDOW_STUCK.reason: 門窗卡住: doors/windows that won't open after deformation; observable indicator. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_NEW_VS_OLD_CRACK.reason: 新舊裂縫: new vs pre-existing crack distinction. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_INSURANCE_CLAIM.reason: 保險理賠: post-quake earthquake-insurance claim process. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_DAMAGE_RECORD.reason: 損傷記錄: documentation of damage status. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_HOA_COMMITTEE.reason: 管委會: HOA management committee. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_PREVENTIVE_MAINTENANCE.reason: 預防性維護: preventive maintenance regimen. No phase 1 equivalent.

AUX_DAMAGE_PROGRESSION.reason: 損傷惡化: progression/worsening of existing damage.

AUX_SELF_HEALING.reason: 自癒: autogenous healing of micro-cracks via cement hydration. Niche concept; not a substitute for engineered repair.

AUX_ELEMENT_JUNCTION.reason: 構件交接: element-to-element interface zone (slab-wall, beam-column joint, new-old concrete). Distinct from E_term_150 梁柱接頭 (a specific junction).

AUX_EXPANSIVE_PRESSURE.reason: 膨脹壓力: internal expansion pressure (rebar corrosion / freeze-thaw). Phase 1 has CAUSE_term_455 鋼筋腐蝕膨脹 — related but specifically rebar-corrosion expansion. Keep broader concept.

AUX_DEEP_DAMAGE.reason: 深層損傷: deep-seated damage detectable only by NDT or core sampling. Distinct from 表面損傷.

AUX_DAMAGE_LEVEL.reason: Same Phase-2.1 canonical (umbrella for A/B/C grading).

E_BALCONY_CANTILEVER.reason: Same structural-element 懸臂梁 (cantilever beam). QA describes balcony cantilever.

T_NETWORK_CRACK.reason: Same damage-pattern 網狀裂縫 / map cracking.

T_HAIRLINE_CRACK.reason: QA 細小裂縫 ≡ T_term_111 髮絲裂縫. Canonical already lists 細小裂縫 as alias.

T_STRUCTURAL_CRACK.reason: QA 結構裂痕 ≡ T_term_076 結構裂縫 (structural crack). 痕/縫 are character variants.

T_BUILDING_TILT.reason: QA 房屋傾斜 ≡ T_term_280 傾斜. Canonical summary explicitly says '建築物偏離垂直方向的現象'.

T_REBAR_CORROSION.reason: QA 鋼筋鏽蝕 ≡ CAUSE_term_118 鏽蝕. Canonical already lists 鋼筋鏽蝕 / Rebar Corrosion as aliases. Dual-role: damage_pattern (observable) + phenomenon/cause (electrochemical mechanism).

T_PENETRATING_CRACK.reason: Same damage-pattern 貫穿裂縫 (penetrating / through crack).

T_DOOR_WINDOW_CORNER_CRACK.reason: QA 門窗角裂縫 ≡ T_term_1189 牆角裂縫 — canonical's summary explicitly includes door/window corners.

T_FLEXURAL_CRACK.reason: QA 彎曲裂縫 ≡ T_term_110 撓曲裂縫. Canonical lists 彎曲裂縫 alias.

F_P_DELTA_EFFECT.reason: Same concept P-Delta效應. Canonical framed as phenomenon/Cause; QA frames as failure_mode. P-Delta is a 2nd-order amplification (cause) that can lead to instability (failure).

F_STORY_DRIFT.reason: Same concept 層間位移. QA frames as failure_mode but it is technically a response quantity / property. Merge to canonical with note.

CAUSE_SHEAR_FORCE.reason: Same concept 剪力. Adds 水平剪力 alias.

CAUSE_BIDIRECTIONAL_SHEAR.reason: Same concept 反覆剪力 / 雙向剪力. Phase 2.1 canonical already lists 雙向剪力.

CAUSE_CONSTRUCTION_QUALITY.reason: Same concept 施工品質. Canonical category 'general'; QA categorizes phenomenon/Cause. Both valid framings.

CAUSE_DESIGN_DEFICIENCY.reason: Same concept 設計不足. Phase 2.1 canonical.

CAUSE_WATER_INFILTRATION.reason: Same concept 滲水. Phase 2.1 canonical (kept-separate-with-link to T_term_1177).

CAUSE_COVER_FAILURE.reason: Same concept 保護層失效. Phase 2.1 canonical.

CAUSE_TORSIONAL_EFFECT.reason: 扭轉效應 (cause/eccentricity-driven torsion) is the upstream of F_term_475 扭轉反應 (the resulting structural response). 效應 = effect/cause-side; 反應 = response/effect-side.

CAUSE_IMPACT_FORCE.reason: 衝擊力 (impact force quantity) vs CAUSE_term_430 結構碰撞 (the pounding event). Different conceptual layers.

CAUSE_AGED_BONDING.reason: 黏著老化 ≡ CAUSE_term_988 老化劣化 specialized to adhesive materials. Phase 2.1 already merged AUX_AGE_DEGRADATION → CAUSE_term_988 with alias '老化'. Same aging mechanism.

CAUSE_PLAN_IRREGULARITY.reason: QA 不規則平面 ≡ PROP_term_1089 平面不規則. Word-order swap; same concept.

PROP_SHEAR_RESISTANCE.reason: QA 抗剪強度 ≡ PROP_term_445 抗剪能力. Phase 2.1 used the same target with explicit reasoning.

PROP_DUCTILITY.reason: QA 延性 ≡ PROP_term_072 延展性. Canonical lists 延性 / Ductility. NOTE: alias '韌性' (toughness) is mechanics-distinct; not propagated.

PROP_STRUCTURAL_INTEGRITY.reason: QA 結構完整性 ≡ AUX_STRUCTURAL_INTEGRITY 結構整體性. 完整性/整體性 are synonyms.

PROP_BRITTLENESS.reason: PROP_BRITTLENESS (脆性 — the property) and TERM_term_033 (脆性材料 — the carrier material) are at different conceptual levels.

PROP_TILT_RATIO.reason: QA 傾斜率 ≡ PROP_term_915 建築物傾斜率. Critical safety threshold (>1/200).

PROP_CONFINEMENT.reason: QA 圍束效果 ≡ PROP_term_407 圍束效應. 效果/效應 synonyms.

MAT_CONCRETE_COVER.reason: QA 混凝土保護層 / 保護層 ≡ PROP_term_409 保護層. Phase 2.1 used the same target.

CODE_TW_SEISMIC.reason: QA 耐震設計規範 ≡ CODE_term_342 台灣耐震設計規範. Canonical lists 耐震設計規範 / 建築物耐震設計規範及解說 as aliases.

CODE_BLDG_TECH_RULES.reason: Same code 建築技術規則.

AUX_EPOXY_INJECTION.reason: Same repair method 環氧樹脂灌注.

AUX_PRESSURE_GROUTING.reason: QA 壓力灌漿 / 灌漿補強 ≡ AUX_REPAIR_term_325 灌漿補強.

AUX_CARBON_FIBER.reason: Same repair method 碳纖維補強 (CFRP).

AUX_STEEL_PLATE.reason: QA 鋼板補強 ≡ AUX_REPAIR_term_136 鋼板黏貼補強. Canonical lists 鋼板補強 alias.

AUX_RC_JACKETING.reason: RC增厚補強 / RC擴柱: post-installed RC jacket on existing column. Distinct from rebar planting (AUX_REPAIR_term_333) or patch repair (AUX_REPAIR_term_332). No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_CRACK_FILLING.reason: QA 裂縫封填 ≡ AUX_REPAIR_term_324 表面封閉法. Canonical lists 裂縫封閉 / crack sealing.

AUX_REBAR_RUST_PREVENTION.reason: QA 鋼筋除鏽防蝕 ≡ AUX_RUST_TREATMENT (Phase 2.1 canonical 除鏽防蝕). Canonical lists 鋼筋除鏽 / rust treatment.

AUX_PILE_INSTALLATION.reason: QA 植筋補強 / 植筋 ≡ AUX_REPAIR_term_333 植筋. NOTE: QA node_id 'PILE_INSTALLATION' is a translation artefact — 植筋 is rebar planting, not pile installation.

AUX_FOUNDATION_REINFORCEMENT.reason: QA 地基補強 / 基礎補強 ≡ AUX_REPAIR_term_330 基礎補強.

AUX_WATERPROOFING.reason: QA 防水處理 / 防水修補 / 防水工程 ≡ AUX_REPAIR_term_092 防水.

AUX_SEISMIC_RETROFIT.reason: Same repair method 耐震補強.

AUX_VISUAL_INSPECTION.reason: Same inspection method 目視檢查.

AUX_NDT.reason: Same inspection method 非破壞檢測 (NDT).

AUX_ULTRASONIC.reason: Same inspection method 超音波檢測.

AUX_LEVEL_GAUGE.reason: QA 水平儀 ≡ AUX_INST_term_580 水準儀. Canonical lists 水平儀.

AUX_FALL_RISK.reason: Same concept 掉落風險 / 墜物風險. Phase 2.1 canonical.

AUX_REPAIR_COST.reason: QA 修繕費用 ≡ AUX_COST_RANGE anchor. The anchor is the umbrella concept.

AUX_PROFESSIONAL_EVAL.reason: AUX_PROFESSIONAL_EVAL (專業評估) is the inspection METHOD performed by a licensed engineer; ACT_ENGINEER_INSPECTION is the safety ACTION recommendation. Different conceptual layers.

AUX_DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT.reason: 損傷評估: post-quake holistic damage-grading procedure. Distinct from AUX_INSP_term_414 (耐震評估 — pre-quake) and AUX_DAMAGE_IDENTIFICATION (the act of identifying).

AUX_QUALITY_CONFIRMATION.reason: 品質確認: post-repair quality verification.

AUX_CRACK_MONITORING.reason: 裂縫監測 (process) is conceptually distinct from AUX_INST_term_581 裂縫監測器 (instrument).

AUX_LOAD.reason: QA 荷載 ≡ CAUSE_term_009 荷載. Same surface form, same concept.

AUX_CRACK_ANGLE.reason: QA 裂縫角度 / 裂縫方向 ≡ PROP_term_918 裂縫方向.

AUX_DOOR_FRAME_DISTORTION.reason: QA 門框歪斜 ≡ T_term_685 門框變形.

AUX_WATERPROOFING_CONCEPT.reason: QA 防水 ≡ AUX_REPAIR_term_092 防水. Display_name match. Canonical summary general enough.

AUX_TILT.reason: QA explicitly states 傾斜 may apply to any element; T_term_280 is specifically the building-level damage. Respect the QA designer's distinction.

AUX_RUST.reason: QA 鏽蝕 ≡ CAUSE_term_118 鏽蝕. Canonical scope already broad.

AUX_VIBRATION_FREQ.reason: QA 振動頻率 ≡ PROP_term_722 頻率. Canonical lists 振動頻率 alias.

AUX_LIGHT_STEEL_FRAME.reason: QA 輕鋼架 ≡ E_term_049 輕型鋼框架. Note: '輕鋼架' may colloquially refer to interior light-gauge framing (smaller scope).

AUX_DANGER_BUILDING.reason: QA 危樓 / 危險建築 ≡ AUX_BLDG_term_881 危險建築.

AUX_WALL_THICKNESS.reason: QA 牆體厚度 / 牆厚 ≡ PROP_term_1096 牆厚.

AUX_BEAM_TOP_CONNECTION.reason: QA 梁柱交界 ≡ E_term_150 梁柱接頭. Same physical element.

AUX_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT.reason: QA 施工許可 / 建照 ≡ TERM_term_870 建築許可.

E_CEILING.reason: 天花板 (ceiling): non-structural finish element. Phase 1 has T_term_686 天花板掉落 (the damage pattern of ceiling collapse) and M_term_1160 石膏板 (gypsum board material) but not the element concept itself.

AUX_CORNER_COLUMN.reason: 角柱: column at building plan corner. Subjected to biaxial seismic load — distinct seismic risk from interior columns. No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_BRICK_WALL.reason: 磚牆 (brick wall): masonry wall element used in BLDG_BRICK reinforced-brick buildings. Lower seismic ductility than RC shear walls. No phase-1 equivalent at this specificity.

AUX_COLUMN_TOP.reason: 柱頂: top zone of column where it meets beam. Site of maximum negative moment under lateral load. Distinct from E_term_150 梁柱接頭 (the joint itself) and E_term_595 柱腳 (column base). No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_WALL_CORNER.reason: 牆角: wall corner geometric zone (stress-concentration locus). Distinct from T_term_1189 牆角裂縫 (the crack pattern at the corner). No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_BEAM_SLAB_INTERFACE.reason: 梁板交界: horizontal interface between beam and slab. Common location for construction joints. No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_WALL_COLUMN_INTERFACE.reason: 柱牆交界: interface between column and adjoining wall. Stiffness-mismatch zone. No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_STRUCTURAL_ELEMENT.reason: QA 結構構件 has the SAME description as AUX_BEARING_ELEMENT (承重構件) and Phase 2.1's AUX_LOAD_BEARING_ELEMENT — all three are 'umbrella for load-bearing members (柱/梁/剪力牆/承重牆/樓板/基礎)'. Merge into the same canonical to avoid splitting an umbrella concept three ways. Note: in strict civil-engineering terminology 結構構件 includes secondary structural members too, but the QA's enumeration restricts the scope to load-bearing primary members. Flag scope-difference for human review.

T_SURFACE_CRACK.reason: 表面裂痕 / 非結構裂痕: crack confined to plaster/finish layer (not penetrating concrete body). Distinct from AUX_SURFACE_DAMAGE (Phase 2.1 — damage scope category) and T_term_111 髮絲裂縫 (width-defined cousin). The QA defines this by *depth* (cosmetic only), not width.

AUX_COMPOSITE_CRACK.reason: 複合裂縫: simultaneous co-occurrence of multiple crack patterns on one element. Distinct from T_SPALLING_WITH_FINE_CRACK anchor (specific spalling+crack composite) and AUX_COMPOSITE_DAMAGE (Phase 2.1 — generic composite damage). This QA node is specifically the multi-crack composite.

CAUSE_HORIZONTAL_FORCE.reason: 水平力 / 側向力: general horizontal force category (includes seismic + wind). Phase 1 has CAUSE_term_013 地震力 (specifically seismic) — 水平力 is the broader external force category.

CAUSE_VERTICAL_LOAD.reason: 垂直荷載: gravity-direction load (dead + live). CAUSE_term_009 (荷載) is the most general; this is specifically the vertical category.

CAUSE_MATERIAL_SHRINKAGE.reason: 材料收縮: general material volumetric shrinkage during curing/aging. Distinct from CAUSE_term_282 乾縮 (specifically water-loss drying shrinkage).

CAUSE_INSUFFICIENT_STIRRUP.reason: 箍筋間距過大 / 箍筋密度不足: legacy-construction cause for insufficient confinement → brittle column shear failure. No phase-1 equivalent.

CAUSE_OVERLOAD.reason: 超載 / 過載: live load exceeding design value. No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_MULTIDIRECTIONAL_LOAD.reason: 多向受力: components subjected to loads from multiple directions simultaneously. Generalization of CAUSE_BIAXIAL_SEISMIC. No phase-1 equivalent.

AUX_ENV_DETERIORATION.reason: 環境劣化 / 環境老化: environmentally-driven long-term deterioration (moisture, chloride, UV, thermal cycling). Distinct from CAUSE_term_988 老化劣化 (broader aging) — this is specifically environment-driven.

AUX_JOINT_WEAKENING.reason: 接合弱化: weakening of beam-column joint capacity under cyclic load. Damage-side concept; distinct from T_term_279 接頭破壞 (the failure pattern). No phase-1 equivalent.

BLDG_TOWNHOUSE.reason: 透天厝 / 街屋: TW-specific row townhouse low-rise building type. Important context for arcade-related soft-story failure.

BLDG_STEEL_SHED.reason: 鐵皮屋: TW-specific light steel + corrugated metal shed (commonly rooftop add-on).

CAUSE_CONCRETE_SHRINKAGE.reason: 混凝土收縮/乾縮: same concrete-shrinkage phenomenon. QA includes 塑性收縮 and 乾燥收縮 sub-aliases; treat both as the umbrella shrinkage concept.

CAUSE_CONSTRUCTION_VIBRATION.reason: 鄰近施工震動: vibration from adjacent construction as a damage cause; no canonical equivalent.

CAUSE_CYCLIC_LOAD.reason: 反覆載重 (cyclic loading — the LOADING REGIME) is the upstream cause of CAUSE_term_284 疲勞 (fatigue — the resulting MECHANISM). Loading cause vs failure mechanism are different conceptual layers.

CAUSE_DESIGN_EARTHQUAKE_EXCEEDED.reason: 超過設計地震: actual seismic intensity exceeding the design level; no canonical equivalent.

CAUSE_DIFFERENTIAL_SETTLEMENT.reason: 不均勻沉陷/差異沉陷: same differential-settlement cause; standard synonyms.

CAUSE_ENV_FACTOR.reason: 環境因素: umbrella cause covering temperature, humidity, chemical exposure etc.; no canonical equivalent at this generality.

CAUSE_FAULT_RUPTURE.reason: 斷層錯動/斷層破裂: same fault-rupture cause; mechanism identical.

CAUSE_FLEXURAL_MOMENT.reason: 彎矩過大 (excessive moment — overload condition / cause) is conceptually distinct from TERM_term_015 彎矩 (the moment quantity itself).

CAUSE_FREEZE_THAW.reason: 凍融循環: identical display name; same freeze-thaw mechanism.

CAUSE_GROUND_PROBLEM.reason: 地基問題: umbrella cause for geotechnical issues (capacity, voids, fill, soft layers, water-table changes); no canonical equivalent.

CAUSE_ILLEGAL_ADDITION.reason: 違建加蓋: unauthorized addition (especially rooftop) as a cause of irregular load and stiffness; no canonical equivalent.

CAUSE_INSUFFICIENT_COVER.reason: 保護層不足: cause concept (insufficient protective concrete layer). Distinct from AUX_CONCRETE_COVER (the layer itself) which merges to PROP_term_409.

CAUSE_INSUFFICIENT_STIRRUP.reason: Same node_id; canonical display 箍筋間距過大 has 箍筋不足 as alias which matches QA display. Add QA aliases 剪力筋不足, insufficient stirrup.

CAUSE_LIQUEFACTION.reason: 土壤液化/液化: same soil-liquefaction phenomenon; standard variants.

CAUSE_LOW_CONCRETE_STRENGTH.reason: 混凝土強度不足: cause/phenomenon — actual compressive strength below design value; no canonical equivalent.

CAUSE_MATERIAL_DEGRADATION.reason: 材料劣化 (generic material degradation — covers any building material) is broader than CAUSE_CONCRETE_DETERIORATION 混凝土劣化 (specifically concrete).

CAUSE_OBSOLETE_DESIGN_CODE.reason: 舊耐震規範不足: building designed under outdated code with weaker requirements; no canonical equivalent.

CAUSE_OPENING_NEAR.reason: 開口應力集中: stress-concentration phenomenon at wall openings (door/window corners). Linked to AUX_OPENING (the geometric feature) and CAUSE_term_585 應力集中 (the broader concept).

CAUSE_PLASTERING_LAYER.reason: 粉刷層收縮龜裂 (the cracking phenomenon in plaster layer — a cause of surface cracks) is conceptually distinct from AUX_PLASTER_LAYER 粉刷層 (the plaster layer material itself).

CAUSE_PLASTIC_DEFORMATION.reason: 塑性變形: identical display name; same beyond-yield permanent-deformation phenomenon (canonical framed as property/state, QA as cause; both acceptable).

CAUSE_POOR_CONSTRUCTION.reason: 施工品質不良 (poor construction quality — the upstream cause) leads to CAUSE_term_989 施工損傷 (construction-induced damage — the downstream phenomenon). Different conceptual layers.

CAUSE_REBAR_CORROSION.reason: 鋼筋鏽蝕/鏽蝕: same rebar-corrosion mechanism; standard variants.

CAUSE_RESONANCE.reason: 共振: identical display name; same resonance phenomenon.

CAUSE_SEISMIC_FORCE.reason: 地震力: identical display name; same seismic-force concept.

CAUSE_SHEAR_FORCE.reason: 剪力作用/剪力: same shear-force concept; QA alias 剪力 = canonical display.

CAUSE_SHORT_COLUMN.reason: 短柱效應: identical display name; same short-column effect (canonical framed as failure_mode, QA as cause; both legitimate).

CAUSE_SITE_EFFECT.reason: 場址效應: identical display name; same site-effect concept.

CAUSE_SOFT_STORY.reason: 軟層效應/軟弱層效應: same soft-story phenomenon; standard variants.

CAUSE_STIFFNESS_IRREGULARITY.reason: 剛度分布不均: stiffness irregularity — generic cause, distinct from CAUSE_term_895 (specifically soft-story).

CAUSE_STRESS_CONCENTRATION.reason: 應力集中: identical display name; same stress-concentration phenomenon.

CAUSE_THERMAL_VARIATION.reason: 溫度變化/熱脹冷縮: canonical already has 溫度變化 as alias; both express the same thermal-deformation cause.

CAUSE_TORSION_EFFECT.reason: 扭轉效應: identical display name; matches Phase-2.2 canonical CAUSE_TORSIONAL_EFFECT.

CODE_ATC_20.reason: ATC-20: identical display name; same ATC-20 standard.

CODE_TW_SEISMIC.reason: 台灣耐震設計規範: identical display name; same standard.

E_BEAM.reason: 梁: identical display name; same beam structural element.

E_COLUMN.reason: 柱: identical display name; same column structural element.

E_COLUMN_BASE.reason: 柱底/柱腳: same column-base member-emphasis concept (per Phase 2.2 distinction). AUX_COLUMN_BASE_LOC is the location-emphasis sister concept and stays separate.

E_FOUNDATION.reason: 基礎: identical display name; same foundation element.

E_SHEAR_WALL.reason: 剪力牆: identical display name; same shear-wall element.

E_SLAB.reason: 樓板: identical display name; same slab element.

E_STAIRWELL.reason: 樓梯間/樓梯: same stair structural concept; in seismic damage assessment 樓梯間 (stair enclosure) and 樓梯 (stair) are commonly treated together as one structural feature.

E_WALL.reason: Element anchor; all QA T5 aliases (牆體, 牆面, 牆壁, wall) already present in Phase 2.2.

F_BEARING_FAILURE.reason: 承壓破壞: bearing/local-compression failure mode; no canonical equivalent.

F_COMPRESSION_FAILURE.reason: 壓碎破壞: identical display name; same compression-failure mode.

F_FLEXURAL_FAILURE.reason: 彎曲破壞: identical display name; same flexural-failure mode.

F_SHEAR_FAILURE.reason: 剪力破壞: identical display name; same shear-failure mode (safety-critical, anchor-grade equivalent).

F_TORSION_FAILURE.reason: 扭轉破壞: identical display name; same torsion-failure mode.

SEV_A.reason: Severity anchor; QA T5 aliases (A級, Level A, 嚴重, 嚴重損傷, 盡速遠離級) all already absorbed in Phase 2.1/2.2. No new aliases.

SEV_B.reason: Severity anchor; QA T5 introduces 請教專業技師級 (action-derived informal naming convention).

SEV_C.reason: Severity anchor; QA T5 introduces 自行修補級 (action-derived informal naming convention).

T_DIAGONAL_CRACK.reason: 斜向裂縫: identical display name; same diagonal-crack damage pattern. (Note: 剪力裂縫 / 剪切裂縫 ambiguity vs T_term_018 inherited from Phase 2.1, unchanged here.)

T_EXPOSED_REBAR.reason: 鋼筋裸露: identical display name; same exposed-rebar damage pattern (safety_critical=true preserved).

T_HORIZONTAL_CRACK.reason: 水平裂縫: identical display name; same horizontal-crack damage pattern.

T_MESH_CRACK.reason: 網狀裂縫: identical display name; same mesh-crack damage pattern.

T_SPALLING.reason: 剝落: identical display name; same spalling damage pattern.

T_SPALLING_AND_FINE_CRACK.reason: Display name 剝落與小裂縫 matches anchor exactly (canonical id uses _WITH_, QA used _AND_). Aliases 剝落與細小裂縫, 細小裂縫與剝落 added as typography variants.

T_VERTICAL_CRACK.reason: 垂直裂縫: identical display name; same vertical-crack damage pattern.

T_V_CRACK.reason: V形裂縫: identical display name; same V-shaped crack pattern.

T_X_CRACK.reason: X形裂縫: identical display name; same X-shaped crack pattern (safety_critical=true preserved).
